dependency_text: Own closed local-policy and source-replay tickets provide the preceding comparison and the independently scored Lesson 4.7 source instances. The source search and its published audit remain at their recorded evidence classes.
objective: Test whether a policy using only elementary local Boolean instructions selects useful rules and constructs a sufficient summary for a later read. Challenge it with alternative neighbors, held-out relations, downstream information loss and equal-budget controls.
status: Exploratory finite task. Reward-guided whole-program mutation recovered the relevant pair and an exact two-bit code in all 18 fits versus 5/18 under neutral mutation. Two bits were necessary in nine selective fits. All nine broad fits kept an extra bit. Size-ordered search found all six minimum-width constructions.
title: Discovering a local fold from atomic Boolean instructions
